source_title: What Are Payment Processing Fees For Selling On Etsy
snippet_primary: "Payment processing fees are a set rate plus a percent of the total sale price of the item. This rate and percent vary by country."
subject_exact: Etsy policy states payment processing fees are a fixed rate plus percentage of total sale price, with rates varying by country
local_qualifiers: fee structure: fixed rate plus percentage of total sale price
